transitionSettings.title: Board Transitions
transitionSettings.description: Choose how the board animates when updating to a new message. Transitions control the flip animation style of the characters on your Vestaboard.

transitionSettings.stepSizeDescription: How many rows or columns animate at once. Leave empty for the board default.
transitionSettings.localApiNote: Transitions are supported on the Local API only. If your board is configured to use the Cloud API, transition settings will have no effect. Individual pages can also override this default in the page builder.

none.label: None
none.description: No transition animation — the board updates all characters at once.

reverseColumn.description: Characters flip column-by-column from right to left.

edgesToCenter.label: Curtain
edgesToCenter.description: Characters flip from both edges and meet in the center.

row.description: Characters flip row-by-row from top to bottom.

diagonal.description: Characters flip in a diagonal wave from one corner to the other.

random.description: Characters flip in a random order for a playful effect.
